svg.title: stable-gated
svg.desc: Qwen3-Next attention layer shapes: x has 2,048 dims; q_proj outputs 16 heads x 256 for queries plus another 4,096 for the gate; SDPA output Y (4,096) is multiplied elementwise by sigmoid of the gate, then o_proj maps 4,096 to 2,048. Toy head with 12 channels: most gate values are near 0. Reported for a 15B MoE: first-token attention 46.7 percent to 4.8, max activation 1,053 to 94, perplexity 6.026 to 5.761, RULER at 128K 31.65 to 58.82. An output gate rescales one token read; a state gate changes every later read.
